screened_sources.title: Transmission Error Compensation for Industrial Robots Using Fourier Series
screened_sources.evidence: Repository API metadata + original experimental CSV sample(s)
screened_sources.decision: INELIGIBLE for direct spur-relief inversion: robot gearbox system, no verified matching spur geometry or relief truth. Useful only as a separate signal-processing dataset.

screened_sources.title: Data/code: profile-shift coefficients and nonlinear dynamic spur-gear response
screened_sources.decision: INELIGIBLE for experimental validation; numerical cross-model resource only.

screened_sources.title: Analysis of gear TE considering measured tooth profile errors
screened_sources.evidence: Downloaded full text R07; Data availability section
screened_sources.relief_of_same_gear_documented: helical measured profiles in publication; no downloaded raw profile/TE pairing
screened_sources.decision: PROMISING reference, but raw data are available on reasonable request, not a verified public download. Helical operator required.
screened_sources.license: See article and any future data licence separately

screened_sources.title: Static/dynamic TE of helical pairs with various tooth modifications
screened_sources.evidence: Verified metadata/abstract only; no full text or raw dataset obtained
screened_sources.relief_of_same_gear_documented: reported modifications; raw pairing not obtained
screened_sources.decision: PROMISING lead; cannot digitize or claim raw experimental validation from an abstract.

screened_sources.title: Laboratory Scale Gear Faults Data
screened_sources.evidence: Primary repository description: fault conditions, load conditions and sensor locations
screened_sources.decision: INELIGIBLE at screening stage: fault/vibration data are not a verified relief + TE pair.

screened_sources.title: High-precision herringbone mesh excitation and tooth-surface modification design data
screened_sources.evidence: Indexed Chinese repository description; dynamic detail/download not obtained
screened_sources.measured_TE: not verified; description includes LTCA simulations and vibration experiments
screened_sources.decision: UNRESOLVED lead: no raw data obtained; herringbone geometry differs from spur test. Not a validated dataset.

screened_sources.title: Reduction of gear pair TE with tooth profile modification (ISMA 2008)
screened_sources.evidence: Primary repository abstract: static FE parametric study
screened_sources.measured_TE: not established: described results are FE
screened_sources.decision: INELIGIBLE as experimental evidence; potentially useful numerical comparison.

screened_sources.title: Conceptual modular gear-pair validation rig framework
screened_sources.evidence: Primary repository expressly states initial conceptual release; datasets are future work
screened_sources.measured_TE: no measurement dataset in this release
screened_sources.decision: INELIGIBLE: a test-rig design is not measured validation data.
